purpose: Governs execution locus eligibility for Enrichment Twin analysis units. Implements the placement contract from enrichment-twin-mission-spec.md §5. Locus eligibility is gated before cost optimization — governance precedes resources.

localFirstOrdering.rationale: Local-first is a hard law: analysis that can run locally must not be routed to a remote locus without a policy gate. Cost and latency optimization apply only within the eligible set, not before it.

sensitivityClasses.description: Non-identifying perceptual or structural features. No individual can be identified or re-identified from the claim. Safe for any eligible locus.
sensitivityClasses.notes: burst_cloud is listed as eligible but always requires the burst_cloud_placement approval gate from the genesis seed. Absence of approval keeps locus set to local/trusted_private/attested_fog.

sensitivityClasses.description: Object or scene specifics that, in aggregate, could reveal behavioral patterns or preferences. Not directly identifying but sensitive in context.
sensitivityClasses.notes: burst_cloud is ineligible regardless of approval gate. Attestation required for attested_fog; unattrested fog nodes are treated as ineligible.

sensitivityClasses.description: Directly identifying or highly sensitive data. Faces, OCR of personal documents, precise GPS location. Must never leave the trusted perimeter.
sensitivityClasses.notes: attested_fog and burst_cloud are ineligible regardless of approval. text_ocr is listed under both internal and sensitive — the scheduler must treat it as sensitive unless the asset is confirmed to contain only non-personal text.

burst_cloud_placement.rationale: Burst cloud placement crosses a trust boundary. The asset content (or its hash) leaves the local trust perimeter. Explicit approval from the genesis seed approval_profile is required before the scheduler may select burst_cloud as a locus.

host_index_writeback.rationale: Writing enrichment claims back into a System-Space index segment crosses the immutability boundary of System Space. Approval gates the query-API activation path, not a write path. Recommendation per ADR-0002 §3: query-API only, never mutate System Space.

nonClaims: This policy does not claim that local-locus enrichment is free from all data risks — it only constrains which loci may be used per sensitivity class.
This policy does not govern model selection or adapter routing — that is owned by model-router.
This policy does not certify any node as 'trusted_private' or 'attested_fog' — attestation is governed separately by the node identity and attestation pipeline.
Burst cloud eligibility declared here does not mean burst cloud is enabled — it requires the approval gate in the genesis seed approval_profile.
